summaryZh: Heller Brown Lab 研究G蛋白偶联受体如何通过信号转导调控细胞生长、存活和炎症，并影响心脏病、神经炎症及胶质母细胞瘤。实验室利用生化、细胞与分子生物学技术识别通路，再以转基因或基因敲除小鼠研究其生理作用。
researchQuestions: GPCR及其下游通路如何造成与疾病进展有关的持续细胞反应？
topics: 心脏病、神经炎症和胶质母细胞瘤
methods: 生化、细胞及分子生物学技术
转基因或基因敲除小鼠

evidence.quote: Heller Brown Lab | UC San Diego
Our laboratory is interested in mechanisms underlying the regulation of cell growth, survival and inflammation by G-protein coupled receptors (GPCRs)
We use biochemical, cell and molecular biological techniques to identify pathways and subsequently generate transgenic or knockout mice to assess the physiological role of these pathways.

Molecular players of current interest include the small G-protein RhoA, calcium regulated CaM kinase, and the transcriptional co-factors MRTFA and YAP. Our research focuses on their roles in heart disease, neuroinflammation, glioblastoma stem cells and tumor growth.
